record.title: Observe reconnect and read-only option baseline
record.intent: Obtain the already-authorized baseline after the explicit link refresh.
requirements: Wait for operator confirmation of Ethernet reconnect; retain carrier and DHCP evidence.
Require captured ACK with21600second lease for the known client and no gateway/DNS before source-bound TCP5555.
Execute the frozen twelve queries once; no retries, ADB, USB, Web Control, installation, reboot or capability change.
Stop on unexpected traffic, identity, response or recorder failure. Preserve graceful drop statistics and restore temporary host state.
Seal evidence, independently verify the actual result, commit and push.
acceptance: A verified baseline or exact stop condition is preserved.
